releaseNotes: Fix: a Check for Updates during a staged update no longer restarts the staging - the armed job and its acknowledgement survive any number of re-checks
Fix: the real beta.11 to beta.12 incident class - staging a genuinely different payload now cleanly retires the old acknowledgement and helper before arming the new job
Hardening: a failed update now also retires the stale acknowledgement and helper automatically
Update: the installer scenario matrix and compatibility coverage now include every supported public release back to 0.3.3-beta.3
